title: Part
spec: To construct the first expert part, which forms the rectangular section at the top of the cylindrical object, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create the first loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0625, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0625, 0.0) and ends at (0.0625, 0.0312). The third line starts at (0.0625, 0.0312) and ends at (0.0, 0.0312). Finally, the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0312) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Apply a sketch scale of 0.0625 to ensure the dimensions are accurate. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space using Euler angles of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 for rotation and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 for translation. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units in the direction of the normal, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body. The dimensions of this part are 0.0625 units in length, 0.03125 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0625, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0625, 0.0312) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0312) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular section
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
